title: BEFORE YOU START YOR DAY ASK GOD FOR THESE 3 THINGS
text: This is not an ordinary morning. This is a spiritual gateway. The first moments of your day determine the instructions of the day. The protection of the day and the blessings assigned to the day. I hear the spirit of God saying, "Before the day speaks, you must speak." Somebody shout, "Lord, I open my day in your name." >> There are three things every destiny must ask for each morning if you want your day to align with heaven. Today we open the gate of the morning with prophetic authority. The first thing to ask God for divine direction. Proverbs 3:6. In all your ways acknowledge him and he shall direct your paths. Before you start your day, say, "Lord, direct my steps today." I decree your mind will not wander. Your decisions will not mislead you. Your steps will not fall into traps. Your meetings will align with destiny. Your timing will align with heaven. You will not go where God has not sent you. You will not miss who God sent to help you. Direction is the difference between productivity and frustration. Today, may your steps be spiritually engineered. The second thing to ask God for divine favor. Psalm 5:12, "For you, oh Lord, will bless the righteous." You will surround him with favor as with a shield. Favor is the atmosphere of miracles. Favor is what makes a day productive. Favor is what causes doors to open without struggle. Say, "Lord, let favor surround me today. I decree favor in conversations, favor in decisions, favor in opportunities, favor with people, favor in assignments, favor in unexpected places. When favor goes with you, the day becomes a helper, not a burden. This day will treat you kindly. The third thing to ask God for supernatural preservation. Psalm 91:11, for he shall give his angels charge over you. Before you step out, say, Lord, preserve my life today. I decree no accident, no loss, no injury, no attack, no unexpected danger, no emotional breakdown, no spiritual weakness, no satanic ambush. Angels will walk with you. Angels will surround you. Angels will protect you. Angels will defend you. Your life is preserved by the covenant of God. Atmosphere shift morning tongues for opening the day. Begin to pray. Favor descending. Angels deploying. Your day is opening under divine presence. Prophetic words of knowledge for your morning. Someone today will mark the beginning of something new for you. Someone named Joy. Favor is waiting for you today. Someone named Michael. A divine connection is being arranged for you today. A woman. Your anxiety from last night is being replaced with strength. Someone in the US, a document you've been expecting will move today. Someone this day will surprise you with good news, declarations for your day. Say, I walk in divine direction today. I walk in supernatural favor today. I walk in divine preservation today. I refuse confusion. I refuse fear. I refuse delay. I refuse manipulation. My steps are ordered. My hands are blessed. My spirit is alert. My path is covered. Now declare with authority this day align with God's plan for my life. Place your hand on your chest. I decree as you begin your day, God goes before you. God stands with you. God watches over you. God empowers you. God directs you. God favors you. God protects you. Your day will not collapse. Your strength will not fail. Your peace will not be stolen. Your joy will not be interrupted. This day opens with grace. This day continues with power. This day ends with testimony. So shall it be. >> Lift your hands. A thick morning glory is rising around you. I hear the spirit of God saying, "Whoever controls your morning controls your day." Somebody shout, "Lord, take over my morning." >> This wave is the activation of the three things: direction, favor, preservation. But now we go deeper into the spirit dimension behind each one. Isaiah 30:21, "Your ears shall hear a word behind you saying, "This is the way. walk in it. Direction is not just knowing where to go. It is knowing where not to go. Say, "Holy Spirit, open my eyes today." >> I decree today you will not enter wrong environments. You will not talk to wrong people. You will not waste time on wrong conversations. You will not take wrong opportunities disguised as good ones. You will not miss divine timing. Your spirit will pick signals. Your mind will pick instructions. Your ears will hear spiritual whispers. Your heart will sense divine nudges. You will move like a man or woman guided by heaven. Favor is not just kindness. Favor is God touching people to bless you. Say, "Father, anoint me with the oil of favor today. I decree your name will be mentioned in places you've never entered. People will favor you without explanation. Those who forgot you will remember you today. Doors will open without struggle. Hearts will be inclined toward you. Systems will adjust to favor you. Policies will shift to help you. Rules will bend for your sake. Where others fight, you will flow. Where others wait, you will advance. Today, you are surrounded by favor like a shield. Psalm 91:7, "A thousand may fall at your side and 10,000 at your right hand, but it shall not come near you." Say, "Lord, cover me with your invisible shield." I decree no weapon formed today will prosper. No arrow of sickness will land. No accident will touch you. No sudden danger will SURPRISE YOU. NO SETBACK will overtake you. No evil decision will AFFECT YOU. NO SPIRITUAL ATTACK will succeed. No plot of hell will reach you. Your footsteps are shielded. Your movements are protected. Your mind is guarded. Your family is preserved. Your environment is sanctified. Angels walk ahead of you and behind you. Job 38:12. Have you commanded the morning? Say morning align with my destiny. I decree morning winds bring you favor. Morning light exposes hidden blessings. Morning hours open divine opportunities. Morning decisions align with purpose. The morning submits to your prophetic voice. You don't just walk into a day, you command a day. Say every atmosphere of my day come under the blood. I decree atmosphere of peace surrounds you. Atmosphere of clarity covers you. Atmosphere of strength fills you. Atmosphere of joy lifts you. Atmosphere of favor follows you. ATMOSPHERE OF SUCCESS EMPOWERS YOU. Atmosphere of grace embraces you. The invisible environment around you is shifting now. Pray. bracadia. Your day is now spiritually charged. Someone today you will receive unexpected kindness. Someone named Chuku Mecca direction is coming for a decision troubling you. Someone named Sarah, a divine helper will contact you today. A woman, your fear from last night is broken. Someone in the USA, your application will move today. Someone, this day carries a surprise you didn't pray for, but God prepared. Say, I walk in divine direction. I walk in supernatural favor. I walk in divine protection. My spirit is alert. My decisions are guided. My path is blessed. My atmosphere is covered. My helpers are activated. My day is fruitful. My life will testify today. Now shout this day. Listen to my voice and obey. >> Place your hand on your head. I decree the light of God goes with you. The wisdom of God guides you. The favor of God surrounds you. The protection of God shields you. The mercy of God speaks for you. The angels of God accompany you. You will not be confused today. You will not be stranded today. You will not be attacked today. You will not be disappointed today. Your day is consecrated. Your path is illuminated. Your results are guaranteed. So shall it be. Amen. >> The presence of God is thick. The atmosphere is shifting. And I hear the spirit of the Lord saying, "Do not enter the day casually. Enter with dominion." Somebody shout, "I take charge of my day." >> This is the wave where direction becomes clarity, favor becomes attraction, and preservation becomes an invisible fortress around your life. Direction is not merely God showing you the way. It is God building your entire day around purpose. Psalm 37:23, "The steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord." Say, "Lord, engineer my day according to your will. I decree your day will not be random. Your movements will not be wasted. Your time will not be scattered. Your decisions will not mislead you. Your interactions will not drain you. Your energy will not be misused. The Holy Spirit will guide your conversations, locations, decisions, priorities, relationships, opportunities. Your day becomes a prophetic pathway. Favor is not only acceptance. It is spiritual gravity. It pulls people, opportunities, resources, information, connections, platforms, help toward you. Say, favor of God, rest on me like a cloud. Today, I decree anywhere you step today, favor steps before you. Anyone you talk to today feels compelled to help you. Any system you engage today bends toward you. Any place your name appears today becomes a place of approval. Any plan the enemy formed against you turns into blessing. Favor becomes your fragrance today. Preservation is not just protection. It is spiritual immunity. Isaiah 54:17. No weapon formed against you shall prosper. Say, Lord, clothe me with supernatural immunity. Today, I decree immunity from accidents, immunity from sickness, immunity from attacks, immunity from failure, immunity from confusion, immunity from emotional manipulation, immunity from spiritual interference. Where others fall, you will stand. Where others fear, you will flourish. Where others break, you will rise. You are untouchable by the forces of darkness today. Every day carries spiritual energy. Some days carry warfare. Some days carry opportunities. Some days carry new chapters. But according to the word of the Lord, this day will favor you. Say they align with my destiny assignment. I decree your day will not resist you. Your day will not betray you. Your day will not fight you. Your day will not confuse you. Instead, your day will bless you. Your day will lift you. Your day will usher in helpers. Your day will bring divine moments. You are not a victim of the day. You are the commander of the day. Lift your voice. every negative program of this day be cancelled. I decree cancelled attacks, cancelled disappointments, cancelled bad news, cancelled sudden emergencies, cancelled emotional heaviness, cancelled confusion, cancelled setbacks, cancelled spiritual traps. Your day is cleansed by the blood of Jesus. Prayer. You are stepping into spiritual mastery. Someone you will receive clarity that solves a lingering problem. Someone named Ada. This day carries unusual favor for you. Someone named Victor. A door you thought was closed is opening. A woman, your mind is being strengthened. Peace floods you today. Someone in Nigeria, a call of opportunity will come before noon. Someone, God is about to show you that he has not forgotten you. Say this boldly. My day is blessed. My mind is sharp. My spirit is alert. My steps are ordered. My hands are blessed. My words carry power. My atmosphere is protected. My favor is activated. My opportunities are aligned. My results are guaranteed. Now command this day. Yield to God's purpose for my life. Place your right hand on your head. I decree supernatural guidance covers you. Divine favor surrounds you. Heavenly protection shields you. Your atmosphere is saturated with grace. Your environment is guarded by angels. Your decisions are guided by wisdom. Your steps are ordered by the spirit. Your day is shaped by the hand of God. You will not stumble. You will not fall. You will not fear. You will not fail. This day is yours. This day is blessed. This day is fruitful. This day is victorious. So shall it be. Lift your hands. The spirit of the Lord is moving like fresh wind. I hear him saying, I am clothing my people with morning authority. Somebody shout, Lord, clothe me with morning power. This wave is where your morning becomes a mantle. Your voice becomes a weapon and your day becomes a servant. Every day requires wisdom, not general wisdom. Payload wisdom. Ecclesiastes 8:1. A man's wisdom makes his face shine. Say, Lord, give me the wisdom for this day. I decree you will not say what will hurt you. You will not choose what will delay you. You will not trust who will betray you. You will not enter where danger hides. You will not take decisions you regret. Wisdom goes ahead of you like a shield. There is favor that meets you later in the day. And there is favor that meets you immediately. Psalm 90:17. Let the beauty of the Lord be upon us. Say, Lord, let favor meet me first today. I decree before you speak, favor will speak for you. Before you ask, favor will answer. Before you move, favor will go ahead. Before you arrive, favor will prepare the ground. Wherever your feet touch today, the oil of favor will flow. Protection is not absence of danger. It is the inability of danger to touch you. Isaiah 43:2, "When you walk through the fire, you shall not be burned." Say, "Lord, put your mark on me today. I decree spiritual traps, you will not fall into them. Silent attacks, they will not reach you. Hidden plots, they will not prosper. Eyes watching you will go blind. Tongues cursing you will be silenced. Arrows released will return to sender. You are marked by the fire of God. Every day carries packages, blessings, answers, connections, open doors, divine moments, but you must command the day to deliver them. Say they hand over my blessings. Now I decree that they will yield opportunities. The day will yield favor. That day will yield breakthroughs. That day will yield encounters. That day will yield clarity. That day will yield helpers. The day will yield testimonies. Nothing inside this day will resist you. Some days start spiritually polluted. The enemy can program heaviness, confusion, arguments, delays, emotional drain, unnecessary battles, unproductive energy. But this morning you override it. Say every negative script I erase you by fire. I decree this day will not fight you. This day will not drain you. This day will not frustrate you. This day will not intimidate you. This day will not trap you. This day will not disappoint you. Your day is reset by the Holy Ghost. Pray. Masha, your day is spiritually rewired. Someone, your effort today will produce unexpected results. Someone named Joseph, favor is waiting where you are going. Someone named Amaka, God is aligning you with the right conversation today. A woman, strength is returning to your spirit. Someone in the USA, your email of good news arrives today. Someone, a meeting today will open a door you prayed for months ago. Say boldly, "My morning is blessed. My day is commanded. My steps are ordered. My mind is clear. My heart is stable. My spirit is empowered. My favor is active. My protection is secured. My wisdom is flowing. My breakthrough is certain. Now declare with authority this day you will obey the word of the Lord in my mouth. You place your hand on your head. I decree your morning is anointed. Your day is protected. Your path is favored. Your decisions are wise. Your atmosphere is clean. Your energy is renewed. Your progress is guaranteed. Your destiny is moving. Your joy will overflow. Your peace will last. No evil will interrupt your day. No darkness will overshadow you. No attack will touch you. No setback will silence you. Your day begins with victory and ends with testimony. So shall it be. Lift your hands. There is a rushing wind of glory moving right now. The spirit of God is saying, "I will make this day produce more than you expect." Somebody shout, "Let my day produce multiply breakthroughs." This wave is where your day becomes productive, prophetic, accelerated, breakthrough, loaded, miracle sensitive. Expect divine interruptions. The good kind. Breakthrough is not always one big event. Sometimes it is a sequence of small divine moments that create massive change. Say, Lord, let breakthrough moments find me today. I decree a conversation will shift your day. An opportunity will locate you. A divine hint will lead you. A stranger will help you. A message will encourage you. A thought will inspire you. A door will silently open. Breakthroughs will hide in ordinary moments. and appear suddenly. Acceleration is when God compresses time and makes things happen faster than the natural process. Psalm 147:15. He sends forth his command to the earth. His word runs swiftly. Say, "Angels of speed, go ahead of my day." I decree your emails will be answered quickly. Your conversations will be productive. Your activities will progress faster. Your plans will move with ease. Your approvals will come earlier. Your waiting season will shorten. Your results will accelerate. What used to take weeks will take hours. What used to take months will take days. Multiplication is divine mathematics. You sow one, but God gives you many. 2 Corinthians 9 10. He multiplies the seed you have sown. Say, Lord, multiply every good thing in my day. I decree your strength multiplies. Your peace multiplies. Your ideas multiply. Your favor multiplies. Your opportunities multiply. Your influence multiplies. Your impact multiplies. Your productivity multiplies. Your testimonies multiply. You will finish this day with more than you started. The enemy sometimes injects delays, setbacks, distractions, unnecessary conflicts, sudden heaviness, emotional disturbances, unplanned emergencies. But today, the sword of the Lord goes before you. Say, every opposition to my day, scatter by fire. I decree no frustration, no sabotage, no confusion, no setbacks, no emotional storms, no draining conversations, no lastm minute disappointments. Your day will run smoothly. There are days where nothing works, but there are days where everything works. Today is that day. Say, "My day, open with favor, continue with favor, end with favor. I decree favor in meetings, favor in calls, favor in decisions, favor in interactions, favor in transactions, favor in conversations, favor in hidden places, favor in unexpected encounters. Favor will walk before you like a shadow. Pray. The atmosphere above your day has shifted. Someone today you will receive unexpected financial favor. Someone named Chisum. God says I'm sending help into your day. Someone named Kingsley. Your day carries the answer to your silent prayer. A woman, your morning sorrow is turning into joy before evening. Someone in the UK, a door you thought closed is about to open. Someone before the day ends, you will say, "God did this." Say this with authority. My day will overflow with breakthroughs. My day will attract favor. My day will work in acceleration. My day will multiply results. My day will shine with grace. My day will produce testimonies. My day will obey divine instruction. My day will yield everything with my name on it. My day will bless me. My day will not be wasted. Now command day, manifest my breakthroughs in full. Place your hand on your chest. I decree your day is blessed. Your pace is accelerated. Your strength is renewed. Your spirit is empowered. Your favor is multiplied. Your steps are ordered. Your atmosphere is lifted. Your results are guaranteed. Your path is protected. Your testimony is secure. Today will exceed expectations. Today will be fruitful. Today will be peaceful. Today will be supernatural. This day is sealed in the glory of God. So shall it be. Amen. >> Lift your hands. The atmosphere is shifting again. This is not just morning prayer. This is daily coronation. I hear the Lord saying, "I give you authority to reign today." Somebody shout loudly, "I walk in dominion today." This wave is where you stop reacting to the day, you start controlling the day. You stop surviving, YOU START REIGNING. YOU STOP HOPING for good, you start declaring good. You are stepping into divine kingship over your entire day. Everything in creation responds to spiritual authority. Sun, time, light, circumstances, they obey. Job 22:28. You shall decree a thing and it shall be established. Say, every element of this day, hear my voice. >> I decree the light of this day will favor you. The hours of this day will bless you. The minutes of this day will align with you. The environment of this day will work for you. The atmosphere of this day will STRENGTHEN YOU. THE STRUCTURE OF THIS DAY WILL SUPPORT YOU. THE TIMING OF THIS day will synchronize with heaven's plan. Nothing in creation will oppose you today. There are encounters that shift a person for life. Today will not be an ordinary day. Heaven will interrupt you. Say, "Lord, let me encounter you in my day. I decree you will hear God clearly at unexpected moments. Revelation will burst forth in your spirit. Insight will come while you move. Peace will rest on you suddenly. Clarity will drop into your mind. Strength will rise in your heart. A divine whisper will shift your direction. You will know that God walked with you today. Settlement means the battle ends. The matter is resolved. The delay stops. The prayer is answered. The situation changes. The testimony manifest. Say, Lord, settle every issue in my day. I decree financial matters settled, family concerns settled, health burdens settled, legal issues settled, relationship tensions settled, work complications settled, destiny confusion settled, pending opportunities settled. Today will not end with unresolved burdens. People play a major role in destiny. Some can lift you, some can hinder you, some can mislead you, some can connect you, some can bless you. Today, God filters your associations. Say, Lord, align me with the right people. Today, I decree no manipulators will reach you. No deceivers will influence you. No wrong voices will speak into your spirit. No time [music and singing] wasters will waste your day. No negative energy will drain you. Instead, helpers will find you. Supporters will strengthen you. Destiny partners will emerge. Divine connections will locate you. Chosen voices will guide you. Your relationships today will bring life, not frustration. Some battles wait for evening. Some attacks wait for nightfall. Some disappointments strike late in the day. But today the cycle breaks. Say no end of day attack will touch me. I decree you will not end the day in pain. You will not end the day in regret. You will not end the day in confusion. You will not end the day in fear. You will not end the day in loss. You will not end the day exhausted emotionally. Your evening will be peaceful. Your night will be restful. Your spirit will be joyful. Your day is sealed in victory from morning to night. Pray deeply. You have stepped into spiritual kingship. Someone you will experience a breakthrough before sunset. Someone named Ephine, your day carries unexpected favor. Someone named blessing, a call of settlement is coming. A woman, your tears from last night will turn into praise today. Someone in Canada, God is aligning you with a divine helper. Someone, your night will end with peace you have not felt in months. Say this loudly. I dominate my day. I walk in divine encounters. I receive heavenly settlement. I command favor everywhere I go. I cancel every form of delay. I silence every negative influence. I reject every satanic interruption. I attract helpers and supporters. I finish my day with joy. I end my day in victory. Now declare with kingly authority this day you will obey my God and bow to his word in my mouth. Place your right hand on your head. I decree your day is governed by heaven. Your spirit is aligned with God. Your mind is filled with wisdom. Your steps are ordered in excellence. Your hands are empowered for success. Your path is saturated with favor. Your environment is protected by angels. Your dealings are sealed with grace. Your outcomes are guaranteed by prophecy. Your night is secured by peace. You will begin this day with fire and end this day with testimony. So shall it be.
